summary: A council leaves most of a permit order in place and changes who must go out and mark the boundary.
realLife: On review of Dolan’s permit, Tigard’s council assigned the floodplain survey and marking to city engineers. The commission’s order had put the task on the applicant.
inGame: needs: a permit case record with applicant, engineer, boundary. An engineer can explain a site visit by pointing to the change made on appeal.

turns.what: The survey crew finds the flood boundary in a different place from the permit sketch.
turns.pulledBy: The city engineers finish their fieldwork before construction begins.
turns.writesBack: The clerk replaces the sketch with the surveyed line.
